d: The Nuggets defeated the Rockets, 133-124 tonight in Denver. Nikola Jokić contributed a team-high 26 points to go with 11 assists 7 rebounds and 2 three pointers, with Cameron Johnson of the Nuggets adding an additional 19 points (7-13 FG, 2-6 3P) in the game. Alperen Sengun finished with a team-high 28 points along with 11 rebounds for the Rockets in the losing effort. The Nuggets improve their record to 9-5 with the win, while the Rockets fall to 12-5 for the season.
